sildenafil.description: Sildenafil citrate is a PDE5 inhibitor used under medical supervision to support erectile function by improving blood flow during sexual stimulation.
uses: Erectile dysfunction in adult men (prescription use)
precautions: Do not use with nitrates or recreational poppers
Seek urgent care for erection lasting over 4 hours
sildenafil.storage: Store below 30°C in a dry place, protected from moisture.

tadalafil.description: Tadalafil is a long-acting PDE5 inhibitor prescribed for erectile dysfunction and, in some regimens, benign prostatic hyperplasia-related urinary symptoms.
uses: Selected BPH-related urinary symptoms when prescribed
precautions: May cause headache, flushing, or back pain
tadalafil.storage: Store below 30°C away from excess heat and moisture.

vardenafil.description: Vardenafil is a PDE5 inhibitor used to treat erectile dysfunction by enhancing nitric oxide–mediated blood flow when sexually aroused.
vardenafil.storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C.

avanafil.description: Avanafil is a selective PDE5 inhibitor prescribed for erectile dysfunction, generally noted for a relatively rapid onset when taken as directed.

dapoxetine.description: Dapoxetine is a short-acting SSRI specifically indicated for premature ejaculation in adult men when prescribed by a clinician.
precautions: May cause nausea, dizziness, or syncope

sildenafil_dapoxetine.description: Fixed-dose combination of a PDE5 inhibitor with dapoxetine, used when a clinician co-manages erectile dysfunction and premature ejaculation.
uses: Combined erectile dysfunction and premature ejaculation under specialist advice
precautions: Higher side-effect burden than single agents

tadalafil_dapoxetine.description: Combination tablet pairing long-acting tadalafil with dapoxetine for selected men with both erectile dysfunction and premature ejaculation.
uses: Coexisting ED and premature ejaculation when prescribed
tadalafil_dapoxetine.storage: Store in a cool dry place below 30°C.

vardenafil_dapoxetine.description: Combination formulation of vardenafil and dapoxetine for clinician-supervised management of erectile dysfunction with premature ejaculation.

sildenafil_tadalafil.description: Dual PDE5 inhibitor combination marketed for erectile dysfunction; use only under medical advice due to additive vasodilatory effects.
precautions: Elevated hypotension risk with nitrates or antihypertensives

sildenafil_duloxetine.description: Combination product pairing sildenafil with the SNRI duloxetine; identity and indication should be confirmed with a pharmacist before use.
uses: As directed by a registered medical practitioner
precautions: Confirm exact composition on the pack
sources: Brand listing cross-checks; pack verification advised

sildenafil_fluoxetine.description: Combination listing of sildenafil with fluoxetine; verify the printed composition on the product pack before dispensing.
precautions: SSRI and PDE5 safety warnings apply
sources: Brand listings; manual pack verification recommended

tapentadol.description: Tapentadol is a centrally acting analgesic with mu-opioid agonist and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor activity, reserved for moderate to severe pain under specialist supervision.
uses: Moderate to severe acute or chronic pain when prescribed
tapentadol.storage: Store below 30°C in a secure place away from children.

isotretinoin.description: Isotretinoin is an oral retinoid used for severe, treatment-resistant nodular acne under dermatologist supervision with mandatory pregnancy-prevention measures.
isotretinoin.storage: Store below 25°C protected from light and moisture.

baclofen.description: Baclofen is a GABA-B agonist muscle relaxant used to reduce spasticity related to multiple sclerosis or spinal cord disorders.

zopiclone.description: Zopiclone is a non-benzodiazepine hypnotic for short-term management of insomnia when behavioural measures are insufficient.
zopiclone.storage: Store below 25°C in a dry place.

eszopiclone.description: Eszopiclone is a cyclopyrrolone hypnotic used for insomnia, including difficulty falling or staying asleep, under medical advice.

naltrexone.description: Naltrexone is an opioid receptor antagonist used in alcohol dependence programmes and opioid relapse prevention after detoxification.

finasteride.description: Finasteride inhibits type II 5-alpha reductase and is used for male pattern hair loss (typically 1 mg) or benign prostatic hyperplasia (typically 5 mg).
precautions: Not for women who are or may become pregnant

gabapentin.description: Gabapentin is an anticonvulsant used for neuropathic pain and as adjunctive therapy in partial seizures.

pregabalin.description: Pregabalin is used for neuropathic pain, fibromyalgia (where approved), and certain seizure disorders under specialist care.
precautions: Schedule H1 / prescription control in many markets

paracetamol.description: Paracetamol is a widely used analgesic and antipyretic for mild to moderate pain and fever when used at labelled doses.
precautions: Do not exceed labelled daily maximum
paracetamol.storage: Store below 30°C in a dry place.

salbutamol.description: Salbutamol is a short-acting beta-2 agonist used as a reliever for bronchospasm in asthma and COPD.
precautions: Overuse may signal poorly controlled asthma
salbutamol.storage: Store below 30°C; do not puncture or incinerate canister.

budesonide.description: Budesonide is an inhaled corticosteroid used for maintenance control of asthma airway inflammation.
precautions: Not a rescue inhaler for acute attacks

azithromycin.description: Azithromycin is a macrolide antibiotic used for selected bacterial respiratory, skin, and sexually transmitted infections as prescribed.
precautions: Antibiotic stewardship — not for viral colds

amoxicillin_clavulanate.description: Amoxicillin with clavulanate is a broad-spectrum penicillin antibiotic/beta-lactamase inhibitor combination for susceptible bacterial infections.
uses: Respiratory, urinary, and skin infections as prescribed
amoxicillin_clavulanate.storage: Store below 25°C in a dry place.

acyclovir.description: Aciclovir is an antiviral used for herpes simplex and varicella-zoster infections in oral or topical forms as prescribed.
precautions: Start early in the outbreak when possible
Maintain hydration with high oral doses

valacyclovir.description: Valacyclovir is a prodrug of aciclovir used for herpes zoster and genital herpes management under medical advice.

ivermectin.description: Ivermectin is an antiparasitic used for certain worm infestations and selected ectoparasitic conditions as directed by a clinician.
precautions: Not for self-medication of viral illness

fluconazole.description: Fluconazole is an azole antifungal used for candidiasis and other susceptible fungal infections.

modafinil.description: Modafinil is a wakefulness-promoting agent used for narcolepsy, obstructive sleep apnoea–related sleepiness, and shift-work sleep disorder.

armodafinil.description: Armodafinil, the R-enantiomer of modafinil, promotes wakefulness in narcolepsy, OSA, and shift-work sleep disorder.
uses: Excessive sleepiness due to narcolepsy, OSA, or shift-work disorder
precautions: Serious rash is rare but requires stopping the drug

atomoxetine.description: Atomoxetine is a selective norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor used for ADHD in children (over approved ages) and adults.
precautions: Monitor mood and suicidality risk in young patients

duloxetine.description: Duloxetine is an SNRI antidepressant also used for diabetic neuropathic pain, fibromyalgia, and generalised anxiety where approved.
precautions: Serotonin syndrome risk with other serotonergic drugs

sertraline.description: Sertraline is an SSRI antidepressant used for depression, OCD, panic disorder, and related anxiety conditions.
precautions: Monitor for mood changes on initiation

escitalopram.description: Escitalopram is an SSRI used for major depressive disorder and generalised anxiety disorder.

fluoxetine.description: Fluoxetine is a long-acting SSRI used for depression, OCD, bulimia nervosa, and panic disorder as prescribed.

amitriptyline.description: Amitriptyline is a tricyclic antidepressant also commonly used at lower doses for neuropathic pain and migraine prophylaxis.

quetiapine.description: Quetiapine is an atypical antipsychotic used for schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and as adjunctive therapy in major depression.

olanzapine.description: Olanzapine is an atypical antipsychotic for schizophrenia and bipolar I disorder with known metabolic side-effect considerations.

venlafaxine.description: Venlafaxine is an SNRI antidepressant available in immediate and prolonged-release forms for depression and anxiety disorders.

carisoprodol.description: Carisoprodol is a centrally acting muscle relaxant used short-term for acute musculoskeletal pain; it has dependence potential.

thyroxine.description: Levothyroxine replaces thyroid hormone in hypothyroidism and is dose-titrated using TSH monitoring.
thyroxine.storage: Store in original container protected from light and moisture.

metformin.description: Metformin is a first-line oral antidiabetic that reduces hepatic glucose production and improves insulin sensitivity in type 2 diabetes.

prednisolone.description: Prednisolone is a corticosteroid used for inflammatory, allergic, and autoimmune conditions; courses should follow medical tapering advice.
precautions: Do not stop high-dose courses abruptly

propranolol.description: Propranolol is a non-selective beta-blocker used for hypertension, angina, arrhythmia, migraine prophylaxis, and performance anxiety in selected cases.
precautions: Avoid in asthma/COPD unless specialist directed

furosemide.description: Furosemide is a loop diuretic used for oedema due to heart failure, liver, or kidney disease, and for hypertension in some regimens.

clomiphene.description: Clomifene is a selective estrogen receptor modulator used to induce ovulation in selected anovulatory infertility cases.

letrozole.description: Letrozole is an aromatase inhibitor used in hormone-receptor–positive breast cancer and, off-label/protocol-based, for ovulation induction.
precautions: Bone health monitoring in long-term use

tamoxifen.description: Tamoxifen is a selective estrogen receptor modulator used in estrogen-receptor–positive breast cancer treatment and risk reduction.

cabergoline.description: Cabergoline is a dopamine agonist used to treat hyperprolactinaemia and prolactin-secreting pituitary adenomas.
precautions: Cardiac valve monitoring with long-term high doses

conjugated_estrogen.description: Conjugated estrogen tablets (e.g., Premarin) are used for menopausal hormone therapy when clinically indicated.
precautions: Thromboembolism and cancer risk counselling required
Lowest effective dose for shortest duration

estradiol.description: Estradiol tablets are used in hormone replacement and selected endocrine protocols under specialist care.

hcg.description: hCG injections are used in fertility protocols to trigger ovulation and in selected male hypogonadism/cryptorchidism settings.
hcg.storage: Typically refrigerate 2–8°C; follow pack insert (do not freeze).

testosterone.description: Testosterone replacement products (gel, injection, or undecanoate capsules) treat clinically confirmed male hypogonadism.
testosterone.storage: Follow pack: gels at room temperature; some injectables per insert.

bimatoprost.description: Bimatoprost ophthalmic solution lowers intraocular pressure in glaucoma/ocular hypertension and is also used for eyelash hypotrichosis where approved.
bimatoprost.storage: Store below 25°C; discard after labelled in-use period.

orlistat.description: Orlistat is a lipase inhibitor used with diet for weight management in obesity by reducing dietary fat absorption.
precautions: Fat-soluble vitamin supplementation may be advised

rizatriptan.description: Rizatriptan is a 5-HT1B/1D agonist (triptan) used for acute migraine attacks, not for prevention.

sumatriptan.description: Sumatriptan is a triptan used for acute relief of migraine with or without aura.
precautions: Do not exceed labelled dose per 24 hours

tamsulosin.description: Tamsulosin is an alpha-1 blocker that relaxes prostate and bladder-neck smooth muscle to improve BPH-related urinary flow.

topiramate.description: Topiramate is an anticonvulsant also used for migraine prophylaxis; cognitive and metabolic side effects require monitoring.

omeprazole.description: Omeprazole is a proton-pump inhibitor used for GERD, peptic ulcer disease, and H. pylori regimens as prescribed.

metronidazole.description: Metronidazole is an nitroimidazole antimicrobial for anaerobic bacterial and certain protozoal infections.
precautions: Avoid alcohol during and shortly after therapy

cephalexin.description: Cephalexin is a first-generation cephalosporin antibiotic for susceptible gram-positive and some gram-negative infections.
uses: Skin, soft-tissue, and urinary infections as prescribed

tetracycline.description: Tetracycline is a broad-spectrum antibiotic; absorption is reduced by dairy, antacids, and iron.
precautions: Avoid in pregnancy and young children (tooth staining)

doxycycline.description: Doxycycline is a tetracycline-class antibiotic used for respiratory, skin, and tick-borne infections and some acne regimens.

clindamycin.description: Clindamycin is a lincosamide antibiotic for anaerobic and gram-positive infections, including some skin and dental infections.

ciprofloxacin.description: Ciprofloxacin is a fluoroquinolone antibiotic reserved for susceptible infections when alternatives are unsuitable.
uses: Selected UTI, GI, and bone/joint infections

cotrimoxazole.description: Co-trimoxazole (sulfamethoxazole/trimethoprim) treats susceptible urinary, respiratory, and opportunistic infections.

ampicillin.description: Ampicillin is an aminopenicillin antibiotic for susceptible gram-positive and some gram-negative infections.

amoxicillin.description: Amoxicillin is a commonly prescribed aminopenicillin for ear, sinus, chest, and urinary infections caused by susceptible organisms.

amlodipine.description: Amlodipine is a dihydropyridine calcium-channel blocker used for hypertension and chronic stable angina.

enalapril.description: Enalapril is an ACE inhibitor used for hypertension and heart failure; Hypernil is a common Indian brand.

celecoxib.description: Celecoxib is a COX-2 selective NSAID used for osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, and acute pain in selected patients.
precautions: CV and GI risk warnings for NSAIDs

cyproheptadine.description: Cyproheptadine is a first-generation antihistamine sometimes used for allergic conditions and appetite stimulation under advice.

hydroxychloroquine.description: Hydroxychloroquine is a DMARD/antimalarial used for rheumatoid arthritis, lupus, and malaria prophylaxis/treatment as indicated.

raloxifene.description: Raloxifene is a SERM used to treat and prevent osteoporosis in postmenopausal women and to reduce invasive breast cancer risk in selected patients.

anastrozole.description: Anastrozole is a non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor used in hormone-receptor–positive breast cancer in postmenopausal women.
uses: HR-positive breast cancer in postmenopausal women

tretinoin.description: Tretinoin cream is a topical retinoid used for acne and photoaged skin under dermatologist guidance.
tretinoin.storage: Store below 25°C; keep tube tightly closed.

cyclobenzaprine.description: Cyclobenzaprine is a muscle relaxant used short-term for acute musculoskeletal spasm; Flexabenz is a common brand.

ibuprofen.description: Ibuprofen is an NSAID analgesic/anti-inflammatory for mild to moderate pain and fever; Reactin is an ibuprofen brand in some markets.

flibanserin.description: Flibanserin is indicated for acquired, generalised hypoactive sexual desire disorder in premenopausal women in jurisdictions where approved.
precautions: Alcohol interaction boxed warning in some labels
flibanserin.storage: Store at room temperature per pack insert.

ondansetron.description: Ondansetron is a 5-HT3 antagonist antiemetic used for chemotherapy-, radiotherapy-, and surgery-related nausea and vomiting; Vominorm may be a local brand — verify pack.

levofloxacin.description: Levofloxacin is a fluoroquinolone antibiotic for selected respiratory and urinary infections when alternatives are unsuitable.

glimepiride.description: Glimepiride is a sulfonylurea antidiabetic that stimulates insulin release in type 2 diabetes.

esomeprazole.description: Esomeprazole is a PPI used for GERD and acid-related disorders; confirm brand match for Esoprol listings.

diclofenac.description: Diclofenac is an NSAID for pain and inflammation; brand identity for unclear spreadsheet names should be pack-verified.

clenbuterol.description: Clenbuterol is a beta-2 agonist sometimes listed for bronchospasm; it is not an approved weight-loss medicine in many markets and requires careful regulatory/clinical review.
precautions: Regulatory status varies — verify legality and indication

tofisopam.description: Tofisopam is an atypical benzodiazepine derivative used in some countries for anxiety; confirm local approval and pack identity.

trazodone.description: Trazodone is a serotonin modulator antidepressant often used for depression and off-label for insomnia; verify Trazocan pack composition.

zaleplon.description: Zaleplon is a short-acting hypnotic for sleep-onset insomnia; Hypnite brand match should be pack-verified.

cholecalciferol.description: High-dose vitamin D3 (e.g., Architol 6L) is used to correct deficiency under medical supervision.
cholecalciferol.storage: Follow pack insert (often protect from light).

rivastigmine.description: Rivastigmine is a cholinesterase inhibitor used in mild to moderate Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s disease dementia; confirm Rivasmart identity on pack.
